statement: You receive a string s of distinct lowercase letters. Print all its subsequences but the empty one, separated by single spaces, in the order produced by this recursion: at each position, first include the character, then exclude it, and emit at the end of the string. Characters keep their original relative order inside every subsequence.
constraints: All characters are distinct lowercase letters.

example.output: abc ab ac a bc b c
example.why: Include-first exploration emits both-in paths before their shorter variants, ending at single letters.

hint: Emit at position n, where the built prefix is one finished subsequence.
mistake: Printing the empty subsequence too - the task asks for the other 2 to the n minus 1.

tests.expected: abc ab ac a bc b c
